observations: Photo 0: Front view of a silver laptop with black keyboard, HP logo visible on screen bezel. Keyboard has a circular trackpoint. Watermark 'GOLD TECHNOLOGIES POSTED ON JIJI' is overlaid.

Photo 1: Screen shows BIOS System Information with 'Product Name: HP EliteBook Folio 9470m', 'Processor Type: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-3667U CPU', and other system details. HP logo visible on bottom bezel. Watermark present.
Photo 2: Same BIOS screen as photo 1, but from a wider angle showing the full laptop. Keyboard and trackpad visible. Watermark present.

claims.claim: HP folio9470 Intel core i5 laptop
claims.evidence: Photo 1 and 2 show 'HP EliteBook Folio 9470m' and 'Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-3667U CPU', not an i5.
No photo shows the keyboard backlight turned on. The keyboard appears to be standard black keys without visible backlighting in the current lighting.

claims.claim: working perfectly great like brand new
claims.evidence: Photos show BIOS screen, not the OS or any application. No evidence of functionality beyond BIOS. No video or sound test shown.

risks.risk: Keyboard backlight may not work or is not present
risks.proof: Photo of keyboard with backlight turned on in a dark environment

risks.risk: Laptop may not boot into operating system or have functional hardware (e.g., screen, touchpad, ports)
risks.proof: Video showing boot into Windows or Linux, use of touchpad, keyboard, and external peripherals

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or degraded
risks.proof: Video showing laptop running on battery with battery percentage displayed
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery not included or dead

risks.risk: Screen may have dead pixels, cracks, or brightness issues
risks.proof: Photo or video of screen displaying full white and full black screens

proof_requests: Video showing boot into operating system and use of keyboard, touchpad, and ports
Photo of keyboard with backlight turned on in a dark room
Video showing laptop running on battery with battery percentage visible
Photo of screen displaying full white and full black screens
response.reason: The model is identified as HP EliteBook Folio 9470m with an i7 processor, contradicting the seller's claim of an i5. The backlight claim is unverified, and functionality claims are unverifiable remotely. Key risks like battery, screen, and full system operation require proof before pricing.
